t: This is the Ian Mikardo School, a school in Tower Hamlets. It is named after Ian Mikardo, known as Mik, who lived from 1908 to 1993. He was a Labour Member of Parliament who stayed on the backbenches through four decades in the Commons. An ardent socialist and a Zionist, he sat on the Labour Party's National Executive Committee for many years and served as the party's chairman in 1970 to 1971.
